Availability is the proportion of scheduled production time during which the machine was available for production. Calculated as actual_run_time / planned_production_time. One of the three OEE pillars (Availability × Performance × Quality = OEE).
Performance is the ratio of actual production speed to the ideal/maximum speed. Calculated as (ideal_cycle_time × total_count) / run_time. One of the three OEE pillars.
Quality is the proportion of good parts out of total parts produced. Calculated as good_count / total_count. One of the three OEE pillars and the direct quality indicator within OEE.

Overall Equipment Effectiveness is the composite manufacturing performance metric calculated as Availability × Performance × Quality. World-class OEE is typically considered 85% or above. Standard benchmark of manufacturing productivity.
